name: Piercings
overview: Scripture addresses piercings and related body markings with clear instructions and symbolic meanings. Leviticus forbids making cuttings or marks on the flesh, associating such practices with mourning or pagan rituals, while Deuteronomy permits ear piercings as a sign of servitude. The prophetic books highlight ornamental piercings and adornments as objects of judgment, reflecting the heart's condition rather than mere external decoration. Ultimately, the Bible calls believers to honor God with their bodies, discerning the spiritual significance behind these practices.
